modalLead: Health now opens as a dashboard view, with new Shift shortcuts for Health and Inbox, and a cleaner config header.

items.text: Health now opens inside the dashboard — the heartbeat icon no longer has to take you away from your page context. Health is available as an in-dashboard view (like Inbox), with focused filters, score breakdown, and row actions.
The old standalone health page is removed — legacy `/health` links now redirect to the in-dashboard Health view, so there is one clear surface for health triage.
Health view state is steadier — active-tab styling now matches the rest of dashboard navigation, deep-link restore with #health is stable, and Escape returns to bookmarks cleanly.
Jump straight to Health with Shift+H — no command or page hop needed.
Jump straight to Inbox with Shift+I — easier to remember than a digit. 0 still works for existing habits, but the cheat sheet now teaches Shift+I.

Config header is simplified — the extra health icon was removed from config header actions, leaving a cleaner single route back to the dashboard. Status Essentials still keeps an up-to-date broken count and health link target.
Health view copy is now localized end-to-end — all new Health labels and related cheat-sheet entries are present and style-aligned in EN / NL / DE / FR.
